message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts: "2013年以来，被告人孙某某以购买兽药为名，让受害人往其提供的银行卡上汇款，先后骗取183名受害人现金，后由被告人将骗取的现金取出占为己有。" So this is fraud: using false pretenses to obtain money. Likely "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also possibly "非法集资"? But the description is fraud. The act is obtaining money by deception, so "诈骗罪". Also maybe "非法占有他人财物" is part of fraud. No other crimes like "敲诈勒索" because no threat, just deception. So single crime: 诈骗.

Thus answer format: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
